verdicts.reason: A is a reasonable two-column banner: the photo is on the left and the copy is centered in the heart on the right. But the white heart now sits on a white background, so it reads as a faint grey outline and loses the original's layered overlap. The headline is also small for the large panel, and the photo has margins on three sides but touches nothing at the bottom. B keeps the heart overlapping the photo, but it leaves roughly the right 40% of the canvas as dead white space. The heart is cut off at the bottom edge, and 'Nothing Feels As Good' runs past the heart's edge onto the photo and background, so the layout is lopsided and looks unfinished.
